requirements.evidence: All five contract routes exist with the required middleware: routes/web.php:16-27 (password.request/email/reset/update inside `guest`, verification.verify with `auth`, `signed`, `throttle:6,1`). PasswordResetLinkController.php:26-33 validates and always flashes `passwords.sent`, never revealing existence. NewPasswordController.php:34-54 validates token/email/password(min 8, letters, mixed case, numbers, confirmed), resets, rotates remember_token, fires PasswordReset and redirects to '/'. VerifyEmailController.php:17-21 uses EmailVerificationRequest (403 on id/hash mismatch) and redirects to '/'. Theme contract met: config/mail.php:112-117 and resources/views/vendor/mail/html/themes/pegafila.css:242-249 (#0f7490 on .button-primary). Locale pins: .env.example:1,7 and phpunit.xml:21-24. Missing subject translations added: lang/pt_BR.json:559,804. Views exist at the contracted paths: forgot-password.blade.php:26 form, reset-password.blade.php:23,28 single e-mail input plus hidden token. Edge cases (unknown address, invalid token, weak password, wrong hash, other id, unsigned link, throttle) are handled and tested.

conventions.evidence: Tests ship with the feature (tests/Feature/AccountMailTest.php, EmailVerificationTest.php, PasswordResetTest.php), docs stay in sync (CHANGELOG.md:26-28,35 and docs/business-rules.md:234-240), no migrations/actions/Livewire apply here, views use Bulma classes, accessible labels (`for="email"`, reset-password.blade.php:28), escaped output and native inputs. One deviation: NewPasswordController.php:34-38 validates three fields inline, while conventions.md:36-38 asks for a Form Request once rules grow beyond one or two fields; the e-mail rule is also duplicated in PasswordResetLinkController.php:28.

security.evidence: Verification is authorized server-side by EmailVerificationRequest behind `auth`+`signed` (routes/web.php:25-27; VerifyEmailController.php:17-21), covered by 403 tests for wrong hash, foreign id and unsigned URL (EmailVerificationTest.php:38-60). Reset input is validated before use (NewPasswordController.php:34-38); token is checked by Password::reset (52-54). No account enumeration: identical status for unknown addresses (PasswordResetLinkController.php:26-33, PasswordResetTest.php:33-43). CSRF tokens and `{{ }}` escaping in both forms (forgot-password.blade.php:26-45, reset-password.blade.php:23-36); forceFill is deliberate and password/remember_token are rotated (NewPasswordController.php:43-46); route throttles on the sensitive endpoints.

tests.evidence: AccountMailTest.php:18-51 asserts the locale/name pins, the pegafila theme + #0f7490 in the inlined mail, the pt-BR reset subject/body/greeting/button/subcopy (no English fallback) and the verification subject/button/action URL. EmailVerificationTest.php:28-60 covers the valid link, wrong hash, another user id and unsigned link. PasswordResetTest.php:15-126 covers form rendering, link sent to existing user, identical response for unknown addresses, e-mail validation, throttling, reset success with remember_token rotation and PasswordReset event, invalid token, a five-case password-strength dataset and the guests-only redirect. No existing tests were weakened or deleted.

simplicity.evidence: Controllers reuse Laravel's Password broker and EmailVerificationRequest instead of custom services (NewPasswordController.php:35-49, VerifyEmailController.php:19); the reset callback is four lines; the theme is a single CSS file, the format Laravel requires (themes cannot be extended), and the views are minimal standalone Bulma markup as the task allows.

readability.evidence: Small focused methods with clear names (PasswordResetLinkController.php:19-33, NewPasswordController.php:19-57), PHPDoc explaining the non-enumeration and verification behavior (PasswordResetLinkController.php:19-25, VerifyEmailController.php:11-16), standard Laravel naming, consistent sibling controller style, no dead code or debug output, and grouping comments in pegafila.css.

scope.evidence: Every hunk serves the task: .env.example and phpunit.xml only add the required locale/name pins (task.md:16-19), the docs and CHANGELOG edits are required by conventions.md:92-103, and all controllers/routes/views/translations/theme are contracted. No login, registration, /home, verification notice/resend, Livewire, layout or SCSS/JS work was added.

issues.explanation: Three fields (including the composed Password rule) are validated inline in the controller, while conventions.md:36-38 asks for a Form Request once rules grow beyond one or two fields, and the e-mail rule is duplicated in PasswordResetLinkController.php:28.
The guests-only requirement is asserted only for password.request; the other three routes in the guest group are not exercised, though the group middleware applies to all of them.

review.summary: The change delivers the pt-BR PegaFila account e-mails: the pegafila markdown theme with brand color #0f7490, the two missing subject translations, locale/name pins, the guest password-reset endpoints and the signed verification route, all covered by Pest feature tests for rendering, the reset flow and 403 paths. It meets the task and the security expectations; the overall 4 reflects a minor convention deviation (three-field inline validation instead of a Form Request) and a small guest-middleware test gap, not any functional problem.
